original_text: 咦？飞鸽传书？肯定又是南贤那个糟老头子。
new_en_US: Another note from Grimm. At least the pigeon knows where to find me.
new_zh_CN: 格林又来信了。至少，这只鸽子还知道去哪里找我。

new_en_US: "Urgent. Come back to my house. I'll explain when you get here. —Grimm"
new_zh_CN: “有急事，快回我家。见面再说。——格林”

new_en_US: The pigeon got a longer briefing than I did. Back to Grimm's, then.
new_zh_CN: 这鸽子知道的，怕是都比我多。得回格林家看看了。
